notes: v1.10: Manual cell entry on the Dashboard, like the Excel sheet. Arrow keys move row (Up/Down) and column (Left/Right, Home/End), with the selected cell shown under the table. Press Enter/F2 (or just type a number) on Return, Sold, Sell Amount or Bill No. to type directly in that cell: Sold adds a new sale, Sell Amount/Bill No. set them on the latest sale, Return returns the box with the typed scale weight (reason asked only if it differs from expected). Esc cancels, Enter moves one column right. Includes v1.9 (table fix), v1.8 (crash-proof startup, safe mode), v1.7 (empty Return), v1.6 (keyboard-first), v1.5 (GOLD/SILVER), v1.4 (client installer), v1.3 (sale Mode/Amount/Bill No.), v1.2 (no cmd window), v1.1 (Ramanand Jewellers, gold icon).
